sloka: कुत: कल्याणसत्त्वाया: कल्याणाभिरतेस्तथा ।चलनं तात वैदेह्यास्तपस्विषु विशेषत: ॥ २.११६.९॥
transliteration: kuta: kalyāṇasattvāyā: kalyāṇābhiratestathā ।calanaṁ tāta vaidehyāstapasviṣu viśeṣata: ॥ 2.116.9॥

translations.english: O dear child, how can goodnatured Sita who is always engaged in performing auspicious deeds, especially towards ascetics be associated with violation of duty?
